title: Data Modeler
description:
This is a remote position.
Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models (ER diagrams, dimensional/star schemas, Data Vault where applicable) for midstream data domains - pipeline scheduling and nominations, volumetric measurement and allocations, gathering and processing, terminal/storage inventory, tariffs and regulatory reporting, and commercial contracts. Own the Bronze → Silver → Gold layering strategy in partnership with data engineering: define what belongs in raw/staging vs. conformed business entities vs. presentation-layer facts and dimensions. Build and maintain dimensional models (fact/dimension design, SCD Type 1/2 strategy, surrogate vs. natural keys, conformed dimensions across business units) for reporting and analytics consumption. Partner with data engineers to translate models into dbt sources, staging models, and marts, and review PRs for adherence to modeling and naming standards. Define and maintain the enterprise data dictionary, entity relationship documentation, and column-level metadata (business definitions, valid values, data lineage) for midstream subject areas. Evaluate source systems ingested via Informatica IDMC/CDIR and dbt, and model how they reconcile into a single conformed view. Lead data model reviews with business stakeholders (commercial, scheduling, accounting, regulatory) to validate that models correctly represent contracts, allocations, and volumetric relationships. Support master data management for core midstream reference entities (assets, meters/measurement points, contracts, counterparties, tariff schedules). Contribute to data governance: naming conventions, modeling standards, data quality rules, and stewardship processes. Assess the impact of new data sources or business changes (new pipeline systems, acquisitions, regulatory changes) on existing models and propose schema evolution strategies that avoid breaking downstream consumers. Required Qualifications 5+ years of data modeling experience (conceptual, logical, physical), including dimensional modeling and normalized/3NF design. Direct experience in midstream oil & gas - hands-on exposure to at least one of: pipeline scheduling/nominations, volumetric measurement and allocations, gas/liquids balancing, terminal or storage operations, or regulatory reporting Strong SQL skills and experience modeling for a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar). Practical experience with dbt (or a comparable transformation framework) - understands how models translate into source()/ref() dependencies, tests, and documentation. Solid grasp of Kimball-style dimensional modeling (star schema, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, factless facts) and when to use Data Vault or 3NF instead. Experience with data modeling tools (erwin, ER/Studio, SqlDBM, dbdiagram, or similar) and producing clear ER diagrams for both technical and business audiences. Comfortable working directly with business SMEs to extract and formalize business rules into a data model - this role requires translating ambiguous operational knowledge into structured schemas, not just implementing a spec handed to you. Understanding of data governance fundamentals: metadata management, data lineage, data quality rules, and stewardship. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Informatica IDMC (or similar ETL/ELT and CDC replication tooling) and understanding of how ingestion patterns (batch vs. CDC) affect downstream model design. Experience with Airflow or another orchestration platform, and how DAG design affects data freshness and dependency management for the models you own. Exposure to medallion/lakehouse architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and the tradeoffs of layering conformed business models vs. raw ingestion. Prior experience in a data governance or data steward capacity.

title: Solutions Architect (Remote, Mexico)
description:

NOVA is an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner and Datadog Partner with a commitment to delivering complex and well-architected technical solutions worldwide. Founded in 2016, our professionals are dedicated to establishing and maintaining trust with our clients and business partners for long-term relationships.
Position Overview:
At NOVA, we believe that the cloud is not just a tool, but a transformative force driving the future of business innovation. As we continue to champion our role as a distinguished AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner, we are on the lookout for an AWS Solutions Architect who not only understands the depth of AWS services but also embodies the principles of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
In this role:
You will be instrumental in migrating workloads to AWS, guiding our clients through the complexities of transitioning their existing systems and applications to the cloud, ensuring a seamless and efficient migration process.
You will champion Operational Excellence, ensuring that our cloud solutions, whether newly designed or migrated, operate smoothly and efficiently, enabling our clients to rapidly adapt to changing business landscapes.
Security will be your watchword, ensuring that every architecture designed is robust, compliant, and resilient against threats, safeguarding our clients' data and business processes.
You will be the guardian of Reliability, ensuring that our solutions are fault-tolerant, highly available, and prepared to meet the demands of our clients' critical business operations.
With an eye on Performance Efficiency, you will leverage the best of AWS services, ensuring that our solutions are optimized for speed, responsiveness, and scalability.
Lastly, understanding the value of every dollar, you will drive Cost Optimization, ensuring that our cloud solutions deliver maximum value without unnecessary expenses.
Collaboration is key in this position. You will be working together with a diverse range of professionals, from our valued customers to dedicated project managers, account managers, and our dynamic engineering team. Reliability Assurance: Design solutions that are fault-tolerant, ensuring high availability and meeting the demands of clients' critical business operations.

Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize solutions for speed, responsiveness, and scalability, leveraging the best cloud provider services.

Cost Management: Ensure that cloud solutions deliver maximum value, optimizing costs without compromising on quality or performance.

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
CHIEF MARKETING OFFICER
We're seeking a Chief Marketing Officer to lead Pavilion 's marketing function and drive growth across new membership bookings, renewals, and new products. This person will oversee product marketing, lifecycle marketing, performance marketing, digital and web experience (brand & content), and sales enablement, including the team responsible for direct outreach and final-stage conversion.
Pavilion serves GTM professionals globally through membership, education, events, and community. Our primary commercial measure is bookings: the cash a customer pays after discounts, whether for a new membership or a renewal.
We need an experienced, tenured marketer who can set a clear strategy, make sound investment decisions, and build a team that takes ownership of results. As a member of executive leadership, the CMO will help determine business priorities and hold peers accountable for the decisions and commitments that support them. You should bring direct experience building acquisition and lifecycle programs, the judgment to challenge agency recommendations, and practical experience using AI to improve marketing team efficiency and performance. The ability to jump into execution to support a lean team as needed will be imperative.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategy and Leadership with Player-Coach Mentality

• Translate business goals into marketing priorities, initiatives, metrics, and a resourcing plan. Work with executive leadership to agree which offerings and audiences take priority.

• Hold executive peers accountable for agreed goals and commitments. Make dependencies visible, challenge conflicting requests, and secure decisions when priorities exceed the team's capacity.

• Build confidence and motivation within the team through clear direction, realistic workloads, useful feedback, and recognition of results. Create an environment where a best-in-class marketing team can propose ideas and question assumptions.

• Develop team leaders across product marketing, lifecycle, performance marketing, and sales enablement. Set responsibilities and recommend hiring or agency support based on business needs.

• Establish a regular review of bookings/other performance with leadership,Finance, and RevOps. Maintain a shared definition of bookings and dashboards that distinguish cash collected from pipeline or unpaid commitments.

• Expertly weave in and out of strategic leadership and pushing things forward. Pavilion is at a stage where the player-coach mindset is critical; it’s not enough to simply know who to ideally hire, our leadership team must be able to jump in and get the job done if needed as well.

Growth Oversight

• Own the marketing plan and budget against agreed targets, with clear contributions from new member acquisition, renewals, and B2B efforts.

• Lead performance marketing across paid media, SEO and AEO, and event acquisition. Evaluate strategy and results with the expertise of someone who has built and run these programs directly.

• Allocate spend based on cash bookings, acquisition cost, retention, and payback. Assess how pricing and discounts affect conversion and the value of each booking.

• Test new channels to reach GTM professionals globally, with clear criteria for expanding, revising, or stopping an investment against a clear geographic strategy that aligns with our Chapter model delivery.

AI and Marketing Operations

• Set priorities for AI agents and automated workflows in areas such as content production, segmentation, reporting, and lead scoring.

• Bring specific examples of tools or workflows you have built or deployed and the measurable effect on cost, output, or performance.

• Equip the team to use these tools responsibly, with clear ownership and review of customer-facing work. Measure whether adoption improves results or saves meaningful time.

Lifecycle Marketing

• Lead lifecycle programs that improve activation, engagement, upgrades and renewal bookings, using member behavior

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Staff Product Security Engineer

The role, in a nutshell

At Chainguard, our security posture is our competitive advantage. As a Staff Product Security Engineer, you will help make secure-by-default development a reality across our products and engineering organization.

You will lead high-impact, cross-functional security initiatives; partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership; and turn complex risks into practical, shippable improvements. A key focus of this role is the AI SDLC: establishing the policies, tooling, and guardrails that enable engineers to use AI responsibly and do the right thing by default-from design and coding through testing, review, deployment, and operations.

This is a hands-on staff-level role for someone who can operate independently, influence multiple teams without direct authority, and raise the security maturity of the organization through both technical execution and strong partnership.

What you’ll do

• Drive product security strategy and execution across multiple products, platforms, and engineering teams.

• Lead the evolution of Chainguard’s secure SDLC, with particular emphasis on the AI SDLC and the changing risks of AI-assisted development.

• Define and implement practical guardrails for AI use in engineering, including secure patterns, policy, workflow controls, review practices, and automation that help teams move quickly while using AI responsibly.

• Partner with Engineering to embed security controls into the full development lifecycle, including architecture, design, coding, testing, code review, deployment, and operations.

• Lead secure architecture reviews and threat-modeling efforts for high-impact systems; identify systemic weaknesses early and guide teams toward scalable mitigations.

• Own cross-functional initiatives such as vulnerability reduction, security automation, and secure-by-default engineering improvements.

• Partner with Engineering to automate vulnerability detection, triage and remediation, including policy-as-code and cloud or container security controls.

• Champion the adoption of security tooling-including static and dynamic analysis, dependency and license checks, infrastructure-as-code scanners, and AI-related controls-within developer workflows and CI/CD.

• Improve how Chainguard runs and consumes security assurance activities such as penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, bug bounty programs, and red-team exercises so findings result in lasting improvements.

• Translate frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and SLSA into durable, automation-friendly engineering controls.

• Stay current on emerging threats, software supply-chain risks, and AI security developments, and turn them into concrete changes to our controls, tooling, and product direction.

• Influence senior stakeholders through clear risk framing, trade-off analysis, and pragmatic recommendations.

• Mentor Product Security Engineers and help raise the security bar across the engineering organization.

What we’re looking for

• 7+ years of experience in software, product, application, or cloud security.

• Experience driving security programs from design through rollout, such as secure SDLC, AI SDLC, vulnerability management, platform hardening, or security automation.

title: Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) - Lafayette, CO
description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Ocean Import Specialist
description:
About Expedock

We are a tech-enabled workforce augmentation platform leveraging top 1% offshore talent & cutting edge technology to enable businesses to unlock their full potential
About the Client
Our client is a US-based logistics provider recognized for delivering reliable, efficient, and customer-focused supply chain solutions. With years of experience in domestic and international freight, they support shippers through smart processes, responsive communication, and modern operational tools. Their services cover a wide range of logistics needs, ensuring that every shipment is handled with accuracy, transparency, and care.
Schedule:Night Shift
Location:Fully Remote (WFH)
The Mission: Manage end-to-end ocean import shipments, ensuring compliance with global trade regulations while proactively identifying, managing, and resolving exceptions through close coordination with overseas agents, carriers, customs brokers, and internal teams.
What You'll Do:

• Pre-Arrival Coordination & Arrival Notice Management

• Receive pre-alert/shipment documents from origin offices or overseas agents.

• Follow up with steamship lines for ISF confirmation, Arrival Notice, and freight invoices.

• Review all charges (ocean freight, origin costs, documentation fees, amendments, etc.) and prepare accurate Arrival Notice billing.

• Issue Arrival Notice + invoice to the consignee/brokerminimum 7 days prior to vessel arrival(or immediately for late vessels) to ensure timely payment and avoid delays.

• Customs Clearance & Last Free Day (LFD) Management

• Coordinate with customs broker for clearance status and resolve any holds (exam, AMS, PGA, etc.).

• Track Last Free Day for both demurrage (storage) and detention (container use) daily.

• Proactively send LFD alerts and reminders to consignee/broker starting 7 days before LFD, then 3 days, 2 days, and daily countdown once inside 48 hours.

• Escalate to management when consignee is unresponsive or LFD is at risk.

• Delivery Coordination & Trucking Arrangement

• Arrange delivery with truckers once cargo is cleared and available (or on wheels if live unload).

• Coordinate with consignee/broker on delivery appointments, special requirements (liftgate, inside delivery, etc.).

• Handle any delivery exceptions (refused cargo, storage orders, redelivery fees) and ensure additional costs are approved and billed to consignee.

• Container Return Monitoring & Detention/Per Diem Management

• Monitor empty container return status daily after delivery.

• Follow up with consignee/trucker for proof of empty return before detention clock expires.

• Calculate and bill any detention/per diem charges incurred due to late return; ensure payment is collected from consignee (never absorbed by us unless pre-approved).

• Dispute incorrect carrier detention invoices when applicable.

• File Closure, Cost Reconciliation & Customer Communication

• Reconcile final carrier and vendor invoices against quoted/billed amounts.

• Issue any debit notes for additional charges (detention, demurrage, exam fees, waiting time, etc.) and follow up for payment.

• Obtain proof of delivery, close file in system, upload all final documents, and release final invoice to customer.

• Act as single point of contact for consignee throughout the shipment: provide proactive status updates, answer queries, resolve issues, and ensure complete customer satisfaction.

What You Need:

• 2-4 years experienceinOcean Import Operations(FCL & LCL required)

• Strong understanding ofUS import proceduresincluding ISF, AMS, PGA holds, customs clearance, demurrage, and detention

• Hands-on coordination experience withsteamship lines, customs brokers, truckers, and overseas agents

• Ability to track and manageLast Free Day (LFD)for both demurrage and detention

• Experience handlingdelivery appointments, trucking arrangements, delivery exceptions, and cost approvals

• Proficiency infreight forwarding systems/TMS

• Amenable to working the night

title: Senior Systems and Certification Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Systems and Certification Engineer to join our team at Collinear Group . As a Sr. Systems and Certification Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our clients and ensuring the certification of aerospace systems in highly regulated environments. Your expertise and experience certifying complex systems with design practices considering system level performance and aerospace certification requirements - such as ARP4754, DO-178, DO-254, DO-160, 14CFR 23/25/29/33/35 and MIL-STDs - will support our mission to make complex aerospace and defense product lifecycles elegantly simple, bending the industry cost curve.
Responsibilities include:

• Developing systems and component level requirements for design and verification within the Systems Engineering and Certification operating group and projects.

• Working closely with cross-functional teams to develop qualification plans and artifacts required for compliance to satisfy regulatory agencies.

Requirements
What you'll need:

• Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering or related field and/or equivalent education and experience

• 5+ years experience in large scale systems design and certification environments

• Advanced experience in design practices with consideration for system level performance and aerospace certification requirements including SAE ARP4754, RTCA/DO-178, RTCA/DO-254, RTCA/DO-160, 14CFR 23/25/29/33/35 and MIL-STDs

• Demonstrated experience with FAA conformity and airworthiness processes, including:

• FAA Form 8130-3 (Authorized Release Certificate / Airworthiness Approval Tag) documenting approval for return to service or airworthiness of aircraft articles

• FAA Form 8130-9 (Statement of Conformity) certifying that articles or test articles conform to the approved design data for certification testing

• FAA Form 8100-1 (Conformity Inspection Record) documenting FAA conformity inspections for certification programs

• Experience supporting FAA certification activities, including coordination with FAA designees (DERs, ODA, or FAA representatives) and participation in conformity inspections and certification audits.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to facilitate teamwork across functions

Nice to have:

• Experience with requirements and program management tools

• Experience in a FAA-regulated environment

• Some ability to work onsite in our Puget Sound service area or occasional travel to customer sites nationwide

• Experience with full Type Certification programs

• eVTOL or AAM program experience

Benefits

Why Collinear?
Join a highly-talented community of like-minded peers practiced at accomplishing big goals. Work on high-impact projects to transform aerospace while developing new skills, insights, connections, and experience.
For this position, Collinear offers a salary range of $140,000 to $165,000 (DOE) with bonus and profit sharing programs, health insurance, HSA contributions, a 401(k) program with company contributions, nine paid holidays, 15 days of PTO accrued per year, non-prescribed amount of sick leave, flexible schedules and remote working capabilities, and multiple company-sponsored employee events - all in support of creating an employee-focused company.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Located in Dourges (Pas-de-Calais), just 25 minutes from Lille , this brand-new 60,000 sqm facility is scheduled to open in March 2027. Designed to support our growing parcel volumes, strengthen network resilience, and relieve existing hubs, LIL2 will handle up to 600,000 parcels per day , serving France and the wider European network.

With 350+ employees and up to 130 operatives per shift , the site will combine advanced sorting technologies, automation, and manual operations. The site’s leadership team will consist of 1 Site Leader, 3 Operations Managers, 10 Shift Managers, and 15 Team Leaders , overseeing operations across three shifts (Early, Late, and Night), six days a week (Monday to Saturday) . 

This structure will ensure strong leadership coverage, operational continuity, and effective team management throughout the week.

title: Research Communications Lead, Physical AI
description:
About us

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

The role

We recently released Encord Data Labs https://encord.com/data-labs/: our research arm through which we'll be sharing some of the lessons learned from our internal research on how data actually moves model performance in the physical world.

We're looking for our first Research Communications Lead, to build and drive our Data Labs research and publishing motion. You won't just be on the author list, you'll be identifying interesting problems and topics to explore, and working with the rest of our ML team to shape their results into research that helps progress our field.

This is a front-row seat to some of the most important technical challenges in physical AI, with a direct line to our research team and co-founders, as well as chance to explore the end-to-end journey of building autonomous systems and getting them to work in the real world.

A taste of what Data Labs has worked on and published in its first months:

- EMG-1 https://encord.com/data-labs/introducing-emg-1/: we released the largest open dataset of wrist EMG synced with egocentric video: 307 hours of real work captured on head and wrist cameras, plus a 10.4-hour lab set with optical mocap, over 30x larger than the next public dataset of its kind

- EMG + vision fusion https://encord.com/data-labs/introducing-emg-1/: by adding muscle signals to camera-based hand tracking, we were able to reduce median fingertip error by ~25%, and ~35% when hands were briefly occluded

- Encord-REACH https://encord.com/data-labs/hands-at-work-egocentric-hand-pose-tracking/: we built a video-native 3D hand pose model for egocentric work scenes, now in production with robotics teams; it cuts wrist tracking error by 80% and joint error by 65%, is 30-70% more accurate on industrial gloves, and almost never swaps in a bystander's hand

- Synthetic data for ANYbotics https://encord.com/data-labs/nvidia-anybotics-synthetic-data/: using NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory to turn 410 reference images of industrial sites into 1,500+ short clips, we lifted ANYbotics' inspection anomaly recall by 24%, for ~$55 of generation

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Overview

The Fulfillment Data Science team works on problems at the core of Instacart's marketplace: how customers choose and experience delivery and pickup, and how we balance speed, reliability, and cost to deliver it. • Ability to turn unstructured quantitative problems into business outcomes by translating business needs into analytical frameworks

• Eagerness to learn, flexibility to pivot when needed, and a growth mindset in a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with the analytical and strategic challenges of working on problems in a multi-sided marketplace

• Experience building, evaluating, and improving statistical, machine learning, and optimization models

• Experience working with geospatial data and methods

• Experience with experimentation in a product-driven setting and in developing experimentation capabilities and tooling

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to lead initiatives across multiple product areas and communicate findings to leadership, product, and engineering teams

• MS/PhD in Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a similar field

You’ll also help ensure our field teams across sales, sales engineering, and customer success can tell that story with confidence. This is a hands-on role. We need an experienced Financial Reconciliation Subject Matter Expert at the Office of the Under Secretary of War (Comptroller) (OUSW(C)). The Comptroller’s office oversees the Department of War’s budget and financial operations, and this team helps organizations across the department produce accurate, auditable financial records. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor and liaison between DoW organizations and enterprise financial operations, supporting the adoption of a financial reconciliation platform that integrates feeder systems and General Ledger (GL) data, and partnering with accountants, financial managers, and system users to resolve reconciliation challenges. RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serves as a trusted advisor and liaison between DoW organizations and enterprise financial operations, supporting adoption and use of a financial reconciliation platform that integrates feeder system and GL data.

• Guides organizations in understanding how feeder system activity impacts GL balances and enterprise financial reporting.

• Analyzes and reconciles complex financial data across multiple systems, organizations, and transaction sources in support of audit readiness.

• Facilitates discovery sessions and working groups to understand business processes, identify control gaps, and define reconciliation requirements between data systems.

• Translates business and financial requirements into actionable solutions and facilitates issue resolution.

• Partners with functional and technical teams to develop and implement solutions that improve financial accuracy, visibility, and operational efficiency.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong understanding of how business activities generate financial transactions, including end to end processes such as Procure to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C), Contract Management, Inventory Management, Asset Accountability, and related feeder systems

• Experience analyzing and reconciling complex financial data across multiple systems and transaction sources in support of audit readiness

• Experience aligning operational transactions with GL balances and financial reporting

• Experience facilitating discovery sessions or working groups with accountants, financial managers, business process owners, and system users

• Ability to translate business and financial requirements into actionable solutions

• Knowledge of financial controls, transaction lifecycle impacts, and financial data integrity practices

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of Air Force financial systems (DEAMS, GAFS, AF WCFs / 5 GLs)

GTM Engineering sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, revenue generation, data, and automation, turning market intelligence and buyer insight into repeatable growth opportunities for PartsBase .

title: Security Incident Response Team Manager
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Ensuring that advanced AI benefits humanity requires protecting the research, infrastructure, and trust that make its development and deployment possible. OpenAI Security defends our model IP, people, products, and users against sophisticated adversaries across GPU supercomputing, multicloud environments, datacenters, and emerging agent systems. The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) leads the response when those defenses are tested-establishing what happened, limiting harm, and strengthening our ability to protect frontier AI.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to build the incident response team that protects OpenAI as AI capabilities and the threats surrounding them evolve. You will command consequential incidents, lead technically demanding investigations, and make containment and recovery decisions when evidence is incomplete and the stakes are high. You will also shape how frontier models change incident response: using OpenAI’s own technology to help responders connect evidence, test hypotheses, and act effectively at a scale that manual workflows cannot support. Partnering with Research, Infrastructure, Product Security, Enterprise Security, IT, and Engineering, you will build exceptional responders, dependable AI-powered capabilities, and stronger defenses through every investigation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Hire, coach, and develop exceptional incident responders who combine investigative depth, engineering ability, and sound judgment. Build a team that challenges assumptions, surfaces uncertainty early, and uses AI to expand its capabilities. Develop technical leaders who can make and explain difficult decisions under pressure.

- Lead incident command for complex threats to OpenAI’s research, products, and infrastructure. Establish severity and scope, coordinate investigation workstreams, and weigh containment options against ongoing exposure and disruption to research or production.

- Build and ship agentic capabilities using OpenAI’s models for evidence collection, investigation context, response coordination, and bounded response workflows. Partner with platform engineers to integrate tools and data, evaluate accuracy and failure modes, and ensure reliable, auditable operation with human approval for consequential actions.

- Set investigation standards for sophisticated adversaries and insider threats across identity, endpoints, cloud, Kubernetes, and large-scale compute. Help responders reconstruct activity, test competing hypotheses, preserve evidence, and make uncertainty explicit.

- Drive incidents to verified closure. Work with accountable owners to validate containment and recovery, document remaining risk, and track corrective actions that reduce the likelihood or impact of recurrence.

- Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy, and other stakeholders throughout an incident. Give executives clear updates on impact, uncertainty, decisions, and the next update without overstating what the evidence supports.

- Build sustainable on-call coverage, escalation paths, and handoffs across regions. Balance urgent response with training and planned improvements, and protect the team’s ability to recover after demanding incidents.

- Build readiness into new research and infrastructure capabilities with their owners. Exercise playbooks, escalation paths, and containment options, including scenarios involving agents operating across systems at scale.

- Turn incident evidence into stronger defenses with Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Security Observability, and security platform teams. Identify what should have exposed an intrusion earlier, what prevented a faster or more confident investigation, and which capabilities would have changed the outcome. Translate those findings into tested improvements with clear owners.

- Prioritize improvements using incident outcomes and readiness evidence. Measure response quality and effectiven

title: Commercial Counsel, Sales
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

 

Your Impact 
As Axon’s Corporate Counsel, you will serve as a key member of Axon’s contracts and corporate team supporting the sales teams around the world. You will partner with members of external teams such as Sales, Supply Chain, Software and Hardware Engineering, Product and IT to structure and negotiate complex transactions, as well as build processes to help build for a rapidly scaling business.

What You’ll Do

Location: Any US Axon hub office location, required to be in-office 4x week (Tuesday - Friday) 

• Provide legal advice to global business partners (primarily including a growing and dynamic Sales organization) on transactional matters related to sale of Axon’s market-leading portfolio of public safety technology products, including, for example:

• structuring, reviewing and negotiating contracts for the disposition of Axon’s goods, services and SaaS solutions; and

• providing and recommending options for business partners with respect to contract negotiations and corresponding risk analyses.

• Supervise and review the Contracts Managers’ work.

• Set and enforce the risk levels acceptable to Axon through approvals and ownership of the knowledge bank and playbooks.

• Lead, support, execute and evolve team processes to help us build Legal contracting support for scale, including, for example:

• drafting, updating and maintaining template contract language, risk analyses, and policies and procedures; and

• supporting the development and implementation of our contract lifecycle management system.

• Provide other legal advice as needed related to Axon’s operations, including, for example, regulatory compliance matters or other legal requirements, and industry standards.

• Collaborate with other attorneys, contracts managers and administrative support to help grow, mentor and learn from others.

What You Bring

• Minimum of 3 years of experience (in-house preferred) negotiating and managing complex commercial contracts.

• Ability to structure, draft, and negotiate a high volume of commercial contracts, including those for the sale of SaaS, hardware, and services.

• Experience negotiating SaaS, IaaS and/or PaaS contracts.

• Ability to act with urgency on all requests.

• Pass-first attitude with a desire to learn new topics and take on new challenges.

• Experience negotiating international agreements.

• Passion for process and organization.

• J.D. and member in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

• Experience with using AI including using it to automate processes building applications to simplify workflows.

• Ability to manage a large workload and pivot quickly between tasks as the business needs change.

Nice To Have

• Deep understanding of other software tools surrounding the contract process, preferably Generative AI, SalesForce, CLMs, and Microsoft Office.

• Experience negotiating with US, State, Local governments and Federal.

• Knowledge of government procurement laws

• Experience negotiating contracts with international government customers preferably Canada and LATAM.

• Previous experience as a sales representative.

• Experience negotiating telecommunication contracts with large telecommunication providers and end users.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of every industry. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. By providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience, we help contractors build trust within their company and with their users.

CompanyCam is a fun, energetic team united by our core values of Show Up, Grow Up, and Do Good. As soon as you join our team, you'll notice that we trust our employees to do what's best for our product, customers, and team members and empower them to make the right calls.

THE ROLE

Do you genuinely enjoy solving customer issues quickly and efficiently, delivering customer feedback to the right teams to enhance the product, and providing all-around top notch support? If you answered 'yes' to all three, you might be a good fit for our team! We're looking for a smart, self-motivated, empathetic, problem-solving Customer Support Specialist to join our Support team.

The CompanyCam Support team is scaling fast. We’re looking for people who can juggle multiple conversations at once while helping others and providing an effortless experience as a whole. If that sounds like something you could get into, read on.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Work with users over live chat, email, SMS messages, and Whatsapp.

- Offer solutions or workarounds for various questions or issues.

- Troubleshoot our product, the users' devices, and our partner integrations.

- Resolving customer issues efficiently across live chat, email, SMS, and WhatsApp to ensure a seamless and positive user experience.

- Collaborating closely with product and engineering teams by capturing and communicating customer feedback that drives product improvements.

- Enhancing the customer journey by contributing to external documentation to empower self service.

- Supporting CompanyCam’s mission to simplify job site documentation by delivering empathetic, high-quality support that builds customer trust and loyalty.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 1+ years of experience in a customer-facing role (SaaS, technology, contact center, retail, food service, etc.).

- Technical savvy, with experience in troubleshooting techniques and best practices.

- Stellar communication skills, both verbal and written, but know it's equally important to listen and understand our customers.

- Experience authoring tutorials and articles for public and internal knowledge bases, preferred.

- Experience working with different support platforms like Intercom, Help Scout, Zendesk, or Salesforce, preferred.

- Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret and act on resources/information.

- A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.

- A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

title: AUMS Tele Remote Bogger Ops Africa 1 (Perth, WA, AU, 6055)
description:
AUMS is part of the Perenti group of companies and is a specialist underground contract mining services business operating across Africa. The business combines a world class workforce with an extensive fleet of specialist underground mining equipment. With a commitment to world-class practices, AUMS has become and will continue to be the ‘contractor of choice’ in the African underground hard rock mining industry.

• Operation of AutoMine systems

• Prepping rings for charging

title: Logistics Lead
description:
About Sunday
Sunday is on a mission to empower everyone to care for their little plot of land. The simple act of getting outside, getting your hands dirty, and caring for your home is more than it seems. It's a reconnection to something written in our DNA, and it's at the core of us working together toward a better planet.
We're bringing safer, science-backed products and personalized, data-driven guidance to the American yard. Our in-house R&D team builds the products. The largest soil database ever created, along with Sunny, our AI yard companion, tailors a plan to every home.
In 2024 we helped our one millionth customer. Today Sunday offers 75+ products across lawn, garden, pest control, and pet, sold online and in about 7,000 stores nationwide, including Home Depot, Walmart, Target, and Costco. On any spring weekend, roughly 750 people are out in their yard using Sunday at any given moment. Sunday is becoming a household name, and we're making a dent.
Position Overview
As the Logistics Lead, you will be responsible for getting Sunday orders to customers. You will own our 3PL relationship with Radial for DTC and Retail fulfillment, manage orders from creation to delivery, and keep shipping fast, accurate, and cost-effective through our spring peak. You will be the main point of contact for Customer Service and Quality on anything that affects delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You will work autonomously, set the standards for how orders flow, and bring the data and judgment the Sr. Director of Supply Chain Operations needs for contract negotiations and strategic decisions. You will partner closely with the Operations Production Director, who owns Costco production and fulfillment through Innomark. Success means orders that arrive on time and in full, a well-run peak season, and a steadily lower cost per order.
Key Responsibilities
3PL Management

• Own the day-to-day Radial relationship, including daily operations, escalations, and weekly and quarterly business reviews

• Hold Radial accountable to SLAs and productivity terms, including units per hour, and drive corrective actions when performance slips

• Plan and staff peak with Radial across Retail Pipe (December-January), Reauth (January to mid-April), and new-subscriber orders (peaking mid-April)

• Manage 3PL production work at Radial, including kitting, pre-kitting, display builds, and rework

Order Management & Shipping

• Own DTC and B2B orders from creation to delivery, finding and resolving stuck, short-shipped, or misrouted orders

• Lead daily B2B order routing, including our Claude-based routing process, and maintain its rules and SOPs

• Partner with the Retail team on wholesale order inquiries and retailer routing and compliance requirements

• Evaluate carriers and ship methods for cost and reliability, and recommend changes

Cross-Team Collaboration

• Partner with Customer Service to run the customer-facing steps of out-of-stock protocols, based on decisions from Planning

• Partner with Quality and vendors to track and reduce defects affecting delivery, including product, packaging, and soil tests

• Define functional requirements for order and shipping systems with Tech, and maintain data integrity across our ERP, Radial, and order systems

Cost, Reporting & Process

• Own logistics budget line items day to day, and find cost savings and avoidance in warehousing and outbound shipping

• Report on logistics KPIs, including on-time and in-full, order accuracy, cost per order, and damage and claims, and provide performance, volume, and cost data for annual Radial contract negotiations

• Review 3PL and carrier invoices with the Purchasing & Inventory Analyst and Finance

• Build and maintain SOPs for order handling, kitting, and shipping

Qualifications
Experience

• 4+ years of experience in logistics, fulfillment, or customer operations, including hands-on 3PL management

• Experience running DTC e-commerce fulfi

title: SOC Analyst (16:00–01:00 UTC)
description:
About the job
The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.
Responsibilities

• Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

• Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

• Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

• Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

• Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

• Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

• Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

• Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

• Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

• Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

• Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

• Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

• Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

• Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.
